title: rosa stylosa subvar. parvula
intro: Rosa stylosa subvar. parvula, commonly known as the Parvula rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa stylosa plant, which is a type of rose species native to China and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine. The Parvula rose is said to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. Its therapeutic actions include sedative, anti-anxiety, and antipyretic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds.
